lines.x: Doctor, there are no express deliveries today, so let me help you sort these documents. Relax, relax—after all this time, I know exactly how they're filed.

Doctor, these are souvenirs I brought back from Rim Billiton—the carrot face cream is good for your skin, and the divination book tells you what to do and what not to do each day... Heheh, I've got a good eye, don't I?

A Messenger can't only watch the road under her feet. If you fret so much over the secrets in the parcel that you miss the scenery along the way, that would be a real shame too... That's right, I really have been thinking—once things quiet down, maybe I could write a travelogue.

This photo? Last time, Tani and the others and I were having lunch on the roof and found a patrol cart, so the four of us struck a pose in front of it... Want one too, Doctor? Sure, I'll take you there right now!

I'm not the high schooler I was when I first got here. All these years I've kept up with my studies and my friends on top of work. If I had to name one regret... if I could, I'd like to attend my own graduation, just once.

Every now and then I catch myself thinking about those ruins in Rim Billiton, imagining how a whole ship could be torn to pieces... No, it's all right. All I want now is to fly faster, and faster still—fast enough that no matter what happens, I can reach your side in time.

Would I go back, if I could live in Siracusa again? I do miss my parents and my friends back home. But just as everyone at Rhodes Island has gotten used to a life with me in it, the people in Siracusa have gotten used to a life without me. So that our reunion can be a better one, we'll carry each other's longing by letter for now.

After being a Messenger for so long, I've picked up the habit of writing letters myself. An Infected's life really is short, so if the day comes when I have to go... I hope every letter I've written can stay with them in another form. The people I don't want to forget, and the people who don't want to forget me.

See? Every time I send a letter, I fold a paper star. Yes, paper stars can't rise into the sky—but they're Angelina's stars, so they can still leave their cramped glass bottle to fly, to circle, to dance... Come dance with me, here under all these stars.
The coffee tastes just like it used to. And things between us are just like they used to be... Mm, this is just fine.
Angelina Ajimu, reporting back for duty... Heheh, it feels a little strange to be this formal all of a sudden, doesn't it, Doctor?
Doctor, look, look! My combat footage made it into the training records!
From my internship to now—it really has been such a long time... But for some reason, every time a moment like this comes around, I get a little nervous.
I've been looking forward to this medal for the longest time—I even saved a spot for it by my bed... And now I finally have it.
Every letter is fragile... Even if it's nothing serious, I can't let my guard down.
I'm plotting the route? No problem—one look and I'll know the fastest way there.
If the ground's blocked, we go by air... There are enemies in the air too? Don't worry, you've got me.
If the fighting can't be avoided... I'm sorry. I have a duty to the ones who trusted me with their letters!
Your letter? I'll rush it through, guaranteed.
Where is this letter headed?
Smooth landing~
Safe landing!
Making things lighter isn't all I can do, you know. Stay put.
An enemy who can't run fast enough gets caught by the wind.
A letter without a proper address gets returned to sender!
Move, move! Somebody's waiting on this letter!
I was going shopping right after the deliveries, but now I'm covered in dust—guess I'm heading back for a hot bath.
That was a nice, light win—let's put on some easy music on the way back and celebrate!
Phew, it's finally over. For a second there I nearly lost my balance... I'll review the footage back home and learn from it.
Doctor, we just weren't prepared enough this time... There was nothing wrong with your command. I believe in you!
Ahh, home—I'm back! This time I'm definitely staying a few more days!
Hmm?
One second, let me touch up my lip gloss... Okay, let's head out!
Arknights.

Still working overtime? The fireworks show already ended... Honestly, what am I going to do with you. Here, watch closely. A little droplet of water floats up, higher and higher—pop! That's my own little firework, just for you. And, Happy New Year, Doctor.
Morning, Doctor! I've got a field assignment today, so let me say good afternoon and good night in advance!

Doctor, sorridi~ Happy birthday. From now on we're taking a photo every year on your birthday, until we fill up a whole album... And then you'd like the album as a present? No, no—I'll be the one keeping it, thank you.

You have no idea what I went through to make it back in time for the celebration. Hmm, should I give you my anniversary message first, or tell you about everything I saw along the way...? Pfft, I really do have so much to tell you. We've got plenty of time, so let's take it slow.
